title: 7 Marks of the Brothers a Godly Man Actually Needs
caption:
7 marks of the brothers a godly man actually needs. Proverbs already told you which ones to keep.

He has your number, not just your handle. He asks about the thing you confessed last month. He can tell when your "I'm good" is a lie, because iron sharpens iron only when it gets close enough to feel the friction. He says the hard thing and stays in the room after.

He shows up to the move, not just the celebration. He prays out loud in front of you without performing it. And he'd rather lose the friendship than watch you drift in silence.

Count how many of your guys actually fit the list.
